long_biography.plain_text:
Before succeeding to hereditary rule, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum had overseen police, aviation and the Jebel Ali Free Zone in his emirate. Raised within the Al Maktoum ruling family, he trained in Britain and entered public service in 1968. He became UAE Vice President and Prime Minister alongside his dynastic office.

His rule has combined infrastructure and trade development with programmes to modernise government services, education and humanitarian work. Equestrian sport supplies a separate, enduring personal dimension. He founded Godolphin from a lifelong interest in horses, developing an international racing and breeding organisation while also competing in endurance riding.
